chunks: God showed (the Makkans) to be few in your dream, for if He had shown them to be many you would surely have lost courage and disagreed about the (wisdom) of the battle. But God spared you this, for He surely knows what is in the hearts of men.
ai.seo_question: Why did Allah show the enemy as few in the Prophet's dream before the Battle of Badr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Battle of Badr, illustrating how divine wisdom managed the psychological state of the believers by reducing the perceived enemy count in the Prophet's dream. This prevented the internal discord and hesitation that would have arisen from seeing a larger force, demonstrating Allah's knowledge of the hearts' fragility. The event underscores the principle that divine guidance often involves subtle adjustments to reality to preserve unity and faith.
